title: Urartu Yerevan celebrate A-League title
description: Urartu - Hatis 90-94 Urartu celebrated A League title. They overcame Hatis on aggregate in the championship series despite return leg game by four points. The guests trailed by 7 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 3-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 94-90. Hatis made 23-of-30 free shots (76.7 percent) during the game, while Urartu only scored seven points from the stripe. 25 personal fouls committed by Urartu helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. American forward Dannie Smith (198, college: IU Northwest) had a double-double by scoring 39 points (!!!) and 10 rebounds (was perfect 8-for-8 from the free throw line) to lead the charge for the winners and the former international forward Davit Khachatryan (210-2000) chipped in 26 points and 18 rebounds during the contest. title: Erebuni are the Champions of the A-League 2024-2025 Season
description: Erebuni became the Champions of the A-League 2024-2025 Season. In the Final game they edged Urartu 105-78. Earlier in the Semifinals Erebuni overcame Lusavan 109-99 as Kenneth Miller (186-G-1995, college: OVU) stepped up with 34 points and Albert Tatevosyan (196-SF-1993) netted 31. Karen Melikyan (192-F-2004) replied with 26 points in a loss. Urartu meanwhile edged Artik 92-75 in another semifinal. Davit Khachatryan (210-F-2000) stepped up with 24 points and 18 rebounds, whilst Marat Mikaelyan (180-G-2005) scored 17.
imageCaption: Erebuni are the Champions of the A-League 2024-2025 Season

title: BKMA win 2024 Championship title
description: FINALBKMA - Mad Foxes 112-91 BKMA outrebounded Mad Foxes 50-30 including a 36-20 advantage in defensive rebounds. BKMA looked well-organized offensively handing out 25 assists. The former international Albert Tatevosyan (196-1993) stepped up and scored 36 points (!!!), 5 rebounds and 8 assists for the winners and the former international center Yura Melikyan (200-2005) chipped in 13 points and 20 rebounds. At the losing side the former international forward Artem Tavakalyan (198-1995, college: Delaware St.) responded with 28 points, 8 rebounds and 7 assists and Lebanese Varant Keledjian (190-1996) scored 16 points and 5 rebounds. Five BKMA and four Mad Foxes players scored in double figures. Mad Foxes' coach gave up on the game allowing to play ten players seeing no chance for a win.

title: Erebuni crowned A League champions
description: FINALErebuni - Urartu 109-107 Erebuni are crowned League A champions. They outscored Urartu in thriller to complete the sweep of the championship series. The hosts trailed by 1 point at the halftime before their 60-57 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Erebuni looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. American guard Omega Harris (190-1995, college: UTEP) orchestrated the victory with a double-double by scoring 29 points, 8 rebounds and 10 assists. He was named the Finals MVP. The other American import Robert Hobson (197-1996, college: JWU, NC, agency: ASEC) contributed with a double-double by scoring 26 points, 12 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners. Hobson is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top summer league for players who want to play basketball overseas. Five Erebuni players scored in double figures.…

title: Vahakni City crowned League A champions
description: Vahakni City - Dvin 87-80 Vahakni City celerbated League A title. They held off Dvin to clinch the trophy. The hosts trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 5-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 87-80. Vahakni City looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. American forward Alvin Brown (210-90, college: USC Aiken) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 20 points and 12 rebounds for the winners and his fellow American import guard Darious Clark (193-90, college: Slippery Rock) chipped in 23 points and 7 rebounds. Clark is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. Five Vahakni City players scored in double figures.
